about: A coal seam on a ridge meadow: coal rocks a miner breaks with a pickaxe, fencing, timber, work lights and a sign, but no job desk, furnace or buyer (the coal goes on to the freighter orders). No building stands there, so the slot is hostless: its kit rests on the probed ground of one free plot. Same shape as ore-face.json. Tooling data: no coordinates and no place names.
